texts.What's a project you're proud of?: claw-consensus - reproducible multi-machine agent consensus, with an offline demo and published evals. It is part of a production 6-machine Claude fleet I run in public: consensus, CRM automation, persistent memory, 100+ automation routines. The part I am proudest of is the accountability: measured reliability evals published (07.2026) - 0/17 high-risk (Tier-2) actions slipped past the human approval gate in recorded runs - and failure modes documented publicly in FAILURE-MODES.md. Repo: github.com/tonydzi (110 public repos; also verbatim-citation-gate, a zero-token gate that catches fabricated RAG citations).
texts.Is there anything else you'd like to add: I am not a classical SWE - I am an operator who ships agent systems end to end (MCP connectors, RAG over a 10-year knowledge base, CRM automation, evals) and can sit in front of a customer: 15+ years founder/BD background, incl. structuring crypto payments and stablecoins with banks and governments in SE Asia. Active US O-1 - authorized to work in the US, no sponsorship needed. Available immediately. https://tonydzi.github.io/
